name: Neutral bounded permit and counter
inputs: internal Boolean state only; no mapped input/output
behavior: Counter increments only when Permit is TRUE and Counter < Limit
Limit is fixed at100; no accumulated offset; Counter never exceeds100
negative_test: Insert syntax error in the task-called Demo_PRG, require real compiler failure, restore valid code and require success if dependency gates pass
stop_on: first unrecoverable public capability or environment gate; no runtime patch or warning waiver
not_claimed: PLC execution, simulated cycle behavior, physical validation
